SUMMARY: This factory builds a single snake plant (Sansevieria) asset: several upright tapering leaves growing from one base, each generated by extruding a profile along a curved bezier spine and shaded with the linked snake_plant material. The upper-level file `snake_plant.py` defines all geometry-node groups (leaf spine, profile width, thickness, rotations) and the `SnakePlantFactory` that places, scales, rotates, and joins the leaves. Note: the current leaves are extruded flat-blade shapes with thickness, NOT round cross-section tubes — achieving the requested round spears requires changing the edge/face extrusion node groups.

EDITABLE (upper-level files — change these to alter the result):
FILE: assets/objects/small_plants/snake_plant.py

  nodegroup_petal_thickness(nw): controls leaf thickness (blade depth) along its length.
    knobs: MapRange out (0.2 -> 0.04) -> thickness tapers thick-at-base to thin-at-tip; thickness Value(uniform 0.1-0.35, random) -> overall leaf thickness scale.

  nodegroup_z_petal_rotation(nw): twists leaf profile about Z along the spline (leaf curl/twist).
    knobs: float_curve points (0,0.25±0.1,0.5±0.15,0.75+0.5,1.0, random) -> twist profile shape; multiply factor(uniform 0.8-2.0, random) -> twist amount.

  nodegroup_x_petal_rotation(nw): bends leaf profile about X along spline.
    knobs: multiply 0.5 * SplineParameter(fixed 0.5) -> bend amount toward tip.

  nodegroup_setup(nw): builds the leaf spine curve.
    knobs: QuadraticBezier Resolution(25) -> spine smoothness; Start(0,0,0)/Middle(0,0,1)/End(uniform -0.2..0.2, uniform 0.2, 2.0, random) -> leaf height (2.0) & tip lean/curve.

  nodegroup_edge_extrusion(nw): sets leaf cross-section WIDTH profile and edge extrusion (this makes flat blade; edit for round tube).
    knobs: init_width(uniform 0.15-0.3, random) -> base leaf width; float_curve width points (init_width, +0-0.1, +0.02-0.18, +0.02-0.1, 0.0 at tip, random) -> width taper to sharp point; CurveToMesh (no profile -> flat) — supply a circle profile here to make round cross-section.

  nodegroup_face_extrusion(nw): applies Z twist then extrudes faces by thickness.
    knobs: Individual(False); uses petal_thickness -> blade depth.

  nodegroup_single_petal_nodes(nw): assembles one leaf.
    knobs: SubdivisionSurface Level(2) -> smoothness/round-ness of leaf; SetShadeSmooth(on).

  check_vicinity(param, petal_params): rejects overlapping leaves at base.
    knobs: r = max(scale*sin(x_rot), 0.2) -> min spacing radius; overlap test r1+r2>dist -> packing density.

  geometry_snake_plant_nodes(nw, **kwargs): places/rotates/scales/joins all leaves and assigns material.
    knobs: attempt loop cap(50, fixed); scale(uniform 0.7-1.0, random) -> per-leaf size; x_rotation(normal(0,0.15), random) -> leaf lean from vertical; x,y base position(uniform -0.7..0.7, random) -> clump spread; z_rotation & z2_rotation(uniform 0..6.28, random) -> leaf facing/orientation; SetMaterial -> snake_plant shader.

  SnakePlantFactory.create_asset: builds asset from a plane, sets leaf count and final scale.
    knobs: petal_num = randint(4,8) (random) -> number of leaves; final obj.scale(0.2,0.2,0.2) -> overall plant size; tag "snake_plant".

LINKED TO INFINIGEN (infra — do NOT edit, resolved from the original package):
  assets/materials/plant/snake_plant.py -> shader_snake_plant: dark green banded/grooved leaf material.
  assets/materials/plant/__init__.py, assets/materials/__init__.py -> material registry access.
  assets/utils/object.py -> object creation/mesh helpers.
  core/nodes/node_wrangler.py -> NodeWrangler / Nodes API for building geometry-node graphs.
  core/nodes/node_utils.py -> to_nodegroup decorator, assign_curve helper.
  core/nodes/node_info.py, compatibility.py, utils.py -> node type metadata and version compat.
  core/surface.py -> add_geomod, shaderfunc_to_material bridging.
  core/placement/factory.py -> AssetFactory base class (seeding, spawn interface).
  core/placement/detail.py -> level-of-detail / resolution management.
  core/tagging.py, core/tags.py -> tag_object semantic labeling.
  core/util/blender.py -> apply_modifiers, apply_transform, purge_empty_materials.
  core/util/random.py, math.py, color.py -> sampling / math / color utilities.
  core/util/logging.py -> logging.
